question: To which deity is this king-syllable formula offered as salutation?
premises: The salutation namo is directed to the deity named jayantīvāgdevatāyai.
The demonstrative ayaṃ identifies the formula just described.
The term nṛpavarṇakaḥ designates this formula as the king-syllable.
inference: Therefore, the described mantra is identified as the king-syllable formula offered in salutation to the goddess Jayantī-vāgdevatā.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of nṛpavarṇakaḥ in this Śrīvidyā context is not fully explicit.
plain_english: Salutation to the goddess Jayantī-vāgdevatā; this is the king-syllable formula.
